name: Wells
overview: Scripture presents wells as vital sources of life and places of significant encounters, as seen when God enables Hagar to find water at Beerlahairoi, symbolizing His provision and care. Wells also serve as points of contention, exemplified by Abraham’s dispute with Abimelech over a well, highlighting the importance of rightful ownership and peace. Additionally, wells mark covenantal moments, such as the oath at Beersheba, underscoring their role in God-ordained relationships and promises.
